summary: Kootenai NF lookout on Smeads Mountain near Noxon, MT: 1930 log cabin, abandoned 1935 per firelookout.com; FFLA lists it as abandoned; no site description today.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1935 per firelookout.com; the FFLA county list says Abandoned, not Gone. No source describes what stands at the site now.

staffing.status: in charge of the lookout station: Homer McFarland

events.note: Homer McFarland had charge of the lookout station on Smeads peak, per a Northern Idaho News item quoted on the Forest Lookouts page

Log cabin per firelookout.com; a June 25, 1930 Sanders County Ledger item quoted on the Forest Lookouts page says the lookout house was being completed. The sources do not say whether the 1928 station was the same structure.

evidence.supports: Location: about 5 miles west of Noxon in Sanders County, Montana
Location name on the Forest Lookouts page: Smeads Mountain
June 1930 Ledger item: two men completing the lookout house on Smead Peak
evidence.quote: Two men are engaged in completing the lookout house on Smead Peak.

evidence.supports: July 1928 Northern Idaho News item: Homer McFarland in charge of the lookout station
evidence.quote: Homer McFarland, who has charge of the lookout station on Smeads peak.

evidence.supports: FFLA lists Smeads as Crowsnest, status Abandoned
Today: the page covers only the 1930 log cabin and the 1935 abandonment, with no site description now

corrections.why: The FFLA county list gives Smeads as Abandoned, and firelookout.com says it was abandoned in 1935. No source says the structure was removed or destroyed.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com (abandoned 1935) and the FFLA list (Abandoned) agree the site is abandoned rather than gone, so the record's gone status is proposed for correction.

notes_for_editor: Two sources agree on a 1930 build. Unresolved: whether the 1928 station and the 1930 cabin are one structure, and log cabin (firelookout.com) versus crow's nest (FFLA). Elevation 5,316 ft (about 1,620 m, converted) could fill elevation_m. No photos found. The record's kind 'platform' was left as is.
